cards.title: Dark mode: colour variables and a toggle in the header
cards.body: In web/styles/tokens.css, declare the colour variables of the dark theme under [data-theme=dark]. Add a toggle button to web/components/Header, the choice kept in localStorage, prefers-color-scheme respected. Criteria: AA contrast on the 5 screens, no flash when the page loads. Proof: light and dark screenshots of the 5 screens.

cards.title: Review of dark mode
cards.body: Read the diff of k1, check the criteria, run the build again and measure the contrast. Send it back if a criterion is missing.

cards.title: Migration of the note lists to the new list component
cards.body: Replace the 14 note lists written by hand in web/screens/ by the component NoteList, with the data in web/data. Criteria: identical rendering, green build. Proof: the diff and before and after screenshots of 3 screens.

cards.title: Redo the home screen (hero, cards, animations)
cards.body: Redo web/screens/Home: a hero with an illustration, 3 notebook cards, entrance animations (transform and opacity only). Criteria: largest paint under 2.5 s, no layout shift. Proof: screenshots at 380 and 1440 px and a performance report.

cards.title: Fix the typo “acme notes” to “Acme Notes” in the footer
cards.body: In web/components/Footer, replace “acme notes” by “Acme Notes” (2 occurrences). Proof: the diff.
